title: Estimate a first-order rate constant from noisy decay data
research_question: What is the rate constant k (in s^-1, and the half-life in s) of a first-order decay observed as a noisy time series?
task_objective: Fit a first-order kinetic model to the provided signal and report k and the half-life WITH THEIR UNITS, with a figure of data + fit.
expected_outputs: outputs/stats.csv containing k_fit and half_life, each with its unit (s^-1, s)
figures/decay.png showing the data points and the fitted curve, time axis in seconds
task_description: A reproduction task: load the signal, fit a first-order decay, report k and half-life.
